Priya Venn
Senior Data Analyst

Summary
Senior analytics leader with 8 years building analytics platforms and leading experimentation programs across fintech products.

Experience
Sunridge Health - Analytics Lead (2018-Present)
- Led an analytics team of 5 and owned the company experimentation program.
- Built a self-serve BI platform with 120+ dashboards, reducing ad-hoc requests by 55%.
- Directed analysis of 200+ experiments informing roadmap prioritization.
- Mentored 4 analysts and set the reporting standards used company-wide.

Skills
SQL, Python, Data Analysis, Machine Learning, analytics, dashboards, business intelligence, experimentation

Education
MS in Data Science, Westmere University
job_description:
Senior Data Analyst

Own analytics and experimentation for our fintech platform. Lead reporting, mentor analysts, and turn data into insights that shape the roadmap.

Requirements:
- 6+ years in data analytics
- Expert SQL and business intelligence tooling
- Experience leading experimentation and analysis
- Ability to mentor and set analytics direction
notes: Strong data-analytics match at senior seniority. Exercises both the data-analytics discipline and the senior case with a high expected band.
